newsitem.title: USA: Calif. controller hospitalized after skating fall.
newsitem.headline: Calif. controller hospitalized after skating fall.

text.p: California state Controller Kathleen Connell was hospitalized after she fractured her hip in a skating accident, her office said on Wednesday.
"She suffered a major hip fracture while rollerblading with her children," said spokesman Byron Tucker. "We expect a full recovery."
Connell, one of the state's top fiscal officeholders, will remain in a Los Angeles-area hospital for a couple of days, Tucker said. Connell is 49.
